description: Owner or office: ask the customer to approve a change order. Doing Work writes the document (the lines, totals and the job's total before and after) and returns a single-use sign_url for the agent to deliver; the customer signs it on a hosted page and the change order becomes approved. To send again after the request was cancelled, call this again; for a fresh link on an open request use signatures.newLink.

signer_email.description: Only this signed-in email may sign. Leave out to bind the job customer's email; refused with 400 when the customer has no email and none is given.

name: changes_send

total_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).
